verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented public API, SDK, or custom-integration framework that a developer could use to push evidence or test results from systems outside the native catalog. The integrations pages describe only auditor-vetted native integrations. The MCP server lets an AI assistant add attachments and status updates to evidence requests, but that is an assistant-facing feature, not a documented developer API for building private integrations. Custom Unified Controls cover control definitions, not evidence ingestion.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover
